title: The Identification of Mitochondrial-Related Biomarkers of Ruptured Intracranial Aneurysms Based on Bioinformatics Analysis and Machine Learning.
authors: Li, Yao; Huang, Dezhang; Wu, Zeyu; Liu, Tao; Sun, Peng
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于生物信息学和机器学习识别破裂颅内动脉瘤的线粒体相关生物标志物，核心是疾病诊断与免疫微环境分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Intracranial aneurysms (IAs) are pathological dilatations of cerebral blood vessels, and their rupture can lead to severe mortality and disability. Therefore, identifying those at risk of rupture is of considerable clinical significance. We screened 3740 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in ruptured IA (RIA) versus unruptured IA (UIA) from the GSE13353 dataset. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was used to identify RIA-related module genes. After the intersection of DEGs and module genes with mitochondria-related genes (MRGs), MTX1, BCL2A1, BID, UCP2, ME2, VAV1, CYBA, and CYBB were identified as mitochondria-associated signatures of RIA. MTX1 was identified as the key diagnostic biomarker using three machine learning methods. While the diagnostic potential of this eight-gene signature was supported by an independent dataset (GSE122897), experimental validation in clinical and animal models confirmed significant dysregulation of ME2, UCP2, BCL2A1, and CYBA in RIA. Notably, MTX1 showed a consistent but non-significant trend of downregulation in these experimental assays. Immune infiltration analysis revealed a pro-inflammatory and stromal-enriched microenvironment in RIA, characterized by significantly elevated abundances of fibroblasts, smooth muscle cells, and macrophages, and showing distinct correlation patterns between key mitochondrial genes and specific immune and stromal cell populations. The construction of transcription factors and endogenous RNA networks was used to identify the underlying molecular mechanisms. Finally, potential therapeutic drugs such as rosiglitazone were identified by drug prediction, and the molecular docking of ME2 with cryptotanshinone suggested a new therapeutic approach. This study may provide a new strategy for the diagnosis and treatment of RIA targeting mitochondria.
abstract_zh: 颅内动脉瘤（IAs）是脑血管的病理性扩张，其破裂可导致严重的死亡率和致残率。因此，识别具有破裂风险的动脉瘤具有重要的临床意义。我们从GSE13353数据集中筛选了破裂性颅内动脉瘤（RIA）与未破裂性颅内动脉瘤（UIA）之间的3740个差异表达基因（DEGs）。采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）识别与RIA相关的模块基因。将DEGs和模块基因与线粒体相关基因（MRGs）取交集后，鉴定出MTX1、BCL2A1、BID、UCP2、ME2、VAV1、CYBA和CYBB作为RIA的线粒体相关特征基因。通过三种机器学习方法，MTX1被确定为核心诊断生物标志物。虽然这一八基因特征的诊断潜力得到了独立数据集（GSE122897）的支持，但在临床和动物模型中的实验验证确认了ME2、UCP2、BCL2A1和CYBA在RIA中的显著失调。值得注意的是，MTX1在这些实验检测中表现出一致但非显著的下调趋势。免疫浸润分析揭示了RIA中促炎性和基质富集的微环境，其特征是成纤维细胞、平滑肌细胞和巨噬细胞的丰度显著升高，并显示出关键线粒体基因与特定免疫和基质细胞群体之间的不同相关性模式。通过构建转录因子和内源性RNA网络来识别潜在的分子机制。最后，通过药物预测确定了潜在的治疗药物，如罗格列酮，并且ME2与隐丹参酮的分子对接提示了一种新的治疗方法。本研究可能为靶向线粒体的RIA诊断和治疗提供新策略。
